item.title: Average household income, UK: financial year ending 2025
item.description: Estimates of average household income in the UK, with analysis of how these measures have changed over time, accounting for inflation and household composition.

item.title: Economic activity and social change in the UK, real-time indicators: 1 October 2026
item.description: Early experimental data and analysis on economic activity and social change in the UK. These real-time indicators are created using rapid response surveys, novel data sources and experimental methods.

item.title: Deaths of people experiencing homelessness in England and Wales: 2013 to 2025 registrations
item.description: The number of deaths of people experiencing homelessness in England and Wales. These are official statistics in development.

item.title: Unexplained deaths in infancy, England and Wales: 2024
item.description: Annual data on sudden infant deaths in England and Wales and infant deaths for which the cause remained unascertained after a full investigation.

item.title: Funded occupational pension schemes in the UK: October 2025 to March 2026
item.description: Financial Survey of Pension Schemes (FSPS) estimates including membership, income and expenditure, assets, and liabilities of pension schemes.

item.title: Population estimates for the UK, England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland: mid-2025
item.description: National and subnational mid-year population estimates for the UK and its constituent countries by administrative area, age, and sex.

item.title: Children living in long-term workless households in the UK: 2025
item.description: Annual UK estimates of the number of children living in households where all adults have not worked for at least 12 months.

item.title: Quarterly economic commentary: April to June 2026
item.description: Economic commentary for the latest quarterly national accounts, prices and labour market indicators.

item.title: Consumer trends, UK: April to June 2026
item.description: Household final consumption expenditure (HHFCE) for the UK, as a measure of growth. Includes all spending on goods and services by members of UK households.

item.title: Deaths registered weekly in England and Wales, provisional: week ending 18 September 2026
item.description: Provisional number of deaths registered in England and Wales in the latest weeks.
